rows.title: Manage templates page, empty, read from the user's stored templates
rows.detail: No real service has notification templates today. Design Release 2.1 adds a Manage templates page that lists a trader's saved templates, and the 9 October templates ruling says templates are create, read, update and delete work that goes ahead now. This first slice builds the page and the store it reads from: the heading, intro line, phase banner, the 'My templates' heading and the results count, built from GOV.UK Frontend components. Templates are stored by the animals backend and kept between sessions, with no seeded examples (c-183). With nothing saved yet the page shows a zero count and an empty list. The page has no sort control: Design Release 2.1's inert 'Sort by:' select is not shipped, and the sort waits on design (c-185). The page's path follows the real service's conventions, not the prototype's (c-258). Later rows add creating, viewing, using, changing and deleting templates on top of this page and store.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in user opening Manage templates sees a page titled 'Manage templates - Import notification service - GOV.UK' with the H1 'Manage templates' (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:9,43; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:15-19; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 17-18)

Under the heading the page shows the line 'Select, manage or create new notification templates' (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:44; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:19)
Manage templates has no Back link: the page starts with its heading (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-012)

The page shows the Alpha phase banner 'This is a new service. Help us improve it and give your feedback by email.', whose feedback link goes to the same feedback address the service's other pages use, never '#' (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:12-17)
The templates are listed under an H2 'My templates' (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:58; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:21)

With no saved templates the page shows 'Show 0 of 0 results' and an empty list, with no empty-state message, no filter, no search, no 'Sort by' control and no pagination control (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:61,77-81; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:22; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 93; c-185)
A user who has never saved a template sees no example templates: the list holds only templates that user has really saved (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claim 10; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 125; c-183)

The page is built from GOV.UK Frontend components (the standard heading, caption and phase banner) rather than the prototype's custom app-dr2-* blocks, and renders as the design does (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24 main outerHTML; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 11)

sources.ref: claim 10 (persistence overrides the prototype's session store)
claims 17, 18 (templates are CRUD and go ahead)

rows.gate: Look at where templates live and the shape of the stored template record (owner, the set it was made in, title, date created, the notification answers it holds), and at the Manage templates page pattern: every later templates row builds its pages and its saves on these.
notes: Re-distil (9 October afternoon and templates rulings): req-1300 now says Manage templates has no 'Sort by' control (c-185 replaced by ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 93-94), so the empty-list criterion adds 'no Sort by control'. The sort itself (req-1299) is blocked on design question 11 in its own row.

Combines the page chrome (req-1291, req-1292, req-1294, req-1296), the list heading, count and empty state (req-1297, req-1298, req-1300), the GOV.UK component rule (req-1306), which every later templates page also follows, and the store (req-1310): one page, one set-up. req-1295 (Templates marked current) stays with the navigation row (inc-152).

Templates belong to both animals sets (live animals and germinal products, ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 51 and 127), so the templates pages are not set pages; they sit in the animals frontend beside the live-animals set's features, where the theme already draws them. The plan may place the folder outside sets/live-animals if the germinal set needs to reach it; say so in the plan.

Plants: no change. Templates cover the animals sets only (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 44), and plants' parked d-038 ruling does not adopt the prototype's templates pattern (repo:plantsfrontend p9-086, p9-087).

rows.detail: On every templates page the service navigation marks Templates as the current item, as Dashboard and Address book are marked on their own pages.
acceptanceCriteria: On Manage templates, and on every templates page as each lands, Templates is the service navigation item marked as current, and Dashboard and Address book are not (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/layouts/main.html:79-95; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-015; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:23)

rows.title: Start a template: the type question offers live animals and germinal products, then the template name and origin in template mode
rows.detail: Creating a template starts from Manage templates' 'Create new template' button with the notification type question, offering only the types whose service stores templates (live animals and germinal products), then asks the template's name and opens the origin page in template mode. Template mode is another way of walking the same journey pages, never a copy of them (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 5, 26-30). Following the button stores nothing; the template is first stored by a form post in the journey (c-309).
acceptanceCriteria: Manage templates has a primary 'Create new template' button, a link styled as a button; following it shows 'What are you importing?' under the caption 'About the consignment', with only the radios Live animals and Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos), none preselected, a 'Continue' button, a Back link to Manage templates and no 'Template' caption; Plants for planting, Potatoes (seed and ware) and Wood products are not offered (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:50-53; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 actions 4-11; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:20, 124-127; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 127-128; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 11; c-220; c-265)
Continuing with no choice shows the page's usual error, whose error summary link moves focus to the first radio (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 11; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 106)
Following 'Create new template' and leaving before submitting any page adds nothing to Manage templates and changes none of the user's drafts (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 47; c-309; c-183)

Continuing from the type question with either type goes to the template name page, titled 'Enter template name - Import notification service - GOV.UK', with the caption 'Create a new template', the H1 'Enter template name', one text input labelled by the H1 with the visually hidden label 'Enter template name', and no hint (prototype:dr2-1-source create-template.html:8,30-45; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 23; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:128-136)

The template name page has a 'Save and continue' button and a 'Cancel and return to manage templates' link to Manage templates (prototype:dr2-1-source create-template.html:48-55; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 23; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:137)

The template name page's Back link goes to the type question when a type has been chosen, and to Manage templates otherwise (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-030; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 23; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:138)

A blank name moves on to Origin of the import with no error, and no length, character or duplicate-name rule is applied; spaces around a name are trimmed (prototype:dr2-1-source create-template.html form novalidate; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T10 actions 11-13; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:174-179)

Going back to the name page part way through creating a template shows the name already entered; starting another new template shows it empty (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-031; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-114)

After a Live animals choice, Origin of the import shows a 'Template' caption with the template name above the caption 'About the consignment', asks the same questions with the same hints and guidance as the origin page shows for a notification, offers only 'Save and continue' with no Cancel link, and its Back link returns to the template name page (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 actions 30-38, T11 action 14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:146-147; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 26-27)

Starting and naming a template creates no notification and changes none: the user's draft notifications on the dashboard are the same before and after (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 125; c-183; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:140-142)

sources.ref: claim 47 (every state change is a form post)

rows.gate: Look at how template mode shows on a question page (the 'Template' caption and name, which buttons and links show, where Back goes), where a template in progress is held, and that template mode is a mode of the same journey pages rather than a copy of them, so later page changes carry over without rework: every later template-mode page, and the germinal set's template mode (req-1876), copies this.
notes: Re-distil (9 October afternoon and templates rulings): following 'Create new template' stores nothing; the template is first stored by a form post (req-1313, c-309), so a criterion observes that. The dependency on 'Region of origin code, internal reference hint and the finished origin page' (inc-010) is dropped: template rows work on the pages as they stand and do not wait for another theme's look changes (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 6, 31-33). The origin criterion now says 'the same questions, hints and guidance as the notification's origin page' rather than naming Design Release 2.1's controls, so it holds before and after the origin theme lands. The dependency on 'Ask What are you importing? before a notification is created' (inc-148) stays: the type question page does not exist today.

Combines the start of template creation: the button (req-1293), the type question in template mode (req-1313, req-1314), the name page (req-1316 to req-1318, req-1320 to req-1323) and the first template-mode question page (req-1324, req-1325). They are one journey a reviewer walks once; split, none can be seen alone.

Combiner: keep the start-and-origin area's req-010 (template mode on the type question) merged here as before, and inc-154's id. The type question lives in the INS front door (c-007); its template mode hands off to the animals frontend's name page. Backend is listed so the plan can hold the template in progress in the template store rather than as a notification.

Template mode must not copy pages or fork the journey (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 5, 30): the 'Template' caption and template-mode save actions change the shared caption and save-actions chrome every question page uses. Plants pages get no template mode (claim 44).
Germinal: choosing Germinal products is observed here only as far as the template name page. What a germinal template asks after its name is req-1876's, in the germinal theme's row.

rows.title: The template's task list and 'What are you importing?' in template mode
rows.detail: While a template is being created, the overview becomes the template's task list and 'What are you importing?' is asked in template mode. A template never offers documents or a declaration (c-264). The task list is the set's own overview in template mode, never a copied page, and shows the notification task list's tasks as they stand.
acceptanceCriteria: While a new template is being created, 'What are you importing?' shows the 'Template' caption and name, has a Back link to Origin of the import, and offers 'Save and continue', 'Save and return to overview' and a 'Cancel and return to overview' link to the template's task list (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 43)

Saving 'What are you importing?' in template mode returns to the template's task list instead of going on to the main import reason (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 actions 46-49; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:145-148)

The template's task list and its question pages show a grey 'Template' tag followed by the template's name in the status strip, in place of the draft status and notification reference (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:92, 149)

The template's task list is headed 'Template tasklist' instead of 'Notification tasklist', and keeps the 'Overview' H1 and the 'Your commodities' figures for animals and packages (0 and 0 before any are entered) (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:93)

The template's task list has five sections, '1. About the consignment', '2. Description of the goods', '3. Transport and arrival', '4. Consignment parties' and '5. Contact address', with no Documents section and no 'Upload documents' task (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:94-96)

A live animals template's task list shows the same tasks, titles and hints as the notification task list shows for the same answers, among them Where is this consignment coming from?, What are you importing?, Commodity details, Identification details, Additional details, Arrival details, Transport details, Roles and addresses and Contact address for this consignment, with no 'Upload documents' task, each opening its question page (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 26, 31)
Each task shows a green 'Complete' tag when answered and a blue 'To do' tag otherwise (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52)

The task list ends with a primary 'Review template' button to the template review and a secondary 'Return to manage templates' button to Manage templates, in place of 'Review and submit' and 'Return to dashboard' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 52; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:97-98)
Nothing on a template's task list or question pages links to Upload documents or the declaration (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 104-105; c-264)

For a notification, the Overview page still shows its status and reference, 'Notification tasklist', its Documents section, 'Review and submit' and 'Return to dashboard' (repo:frontend features/hub; trace:animals-fit hub buttons)
notes: Re-distil (templates ruling): the dependency on 'Hub regions for assistive technology and the Main import reason row' (inc-098) is dropped: it changes only the overview's look and a task title, which the templates ruling names as a dependency to drop (claims 6, 33). The task criterion now says the template task list shows the notification task list's own tasks and titles, so the third task reads 'Main reason for import' until inc-098 lands and 'Main import reason' after, with no rework. The five section names are observable today: the hub already numbers its sections and the template list leaves Documents out and renumbers the two after it.

Combines the commodity page in template mode (req-1326, req-1327), the template task list (req-1328 to req-1333) and the no-documents rule (req-1334): one set-up, a template being created, and one page the others return to. 'Review template' points at the review row's page; its target is observed once that row lands, so the review row follows straight after.
Combiner: keep the notification-hub area's req-814 to req-818 merged here as before, and inc-155's id. A germinal template's task list (no Additional details task) is req-1876's.

rows.title: Review your template before saving it
rows.detail: A template being created ends on the template review, which is the set's own review page in template mode. Its Back link returns to the template's task list, and its Change links open each question page to change the template in progress.
acceptanceCriteria: The template review's Back link returns to the template's task list (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 68; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-089)

While a template is being created, the review's Change links open each question page directly to change the template in progress, such as Origin of the import and the contact address page, and that page shows the template-creation buttons, not 'Save and return' with a 'Cancel' back to a template page (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 68 LINKS; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-092; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103)

sources.ref: claims 6, 33 (no wait for the review's new headings)

notes: Combiner: keep the review-and-submit area's req-941 and req-942 merged here as before, and inc-156's id; this area's two requirements alone are not observable without the review page in template mode.

Re-distil (templates ruling): the dependency on 'Review sections and cards take Design Release 2.1's headings, titles and unfinished-card messages' (inc-101) is dropped: the ruling names the review's new headings as a look-only dependency a template row does not wait for (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 33). The template review works on the review as it stands: today its sections run '4. Documents', '5. Consignment parties', '6. Contact address', so the template review's sections without Documents read '4. Consignment parties' and '5. Contact address' until inc-101 renames them '4. Consignment addresses'. When merging req-942's criteria, write the section criterion to hold either way (the review's own numbered sections, without the documents section, renumbered to run 1 to 5), or say in notes that the heading text follows inc-101. Keep the dependency on inc-155 (the task list's 'Review template' button).
backend is listed only where saving from the review needs the templates store; the plan may find no backend change here.

rows.title: Save a template and see it on Manage templates
rows.detail: 'Save template' stores the template, even part answered, and returns to Manage templates with a success banner and the new template first in the list. Each card shows its title, a 'View template' link and a 'Use template' button in a form that posts (c-309). Templates are kept by the backend between sessions and belong to the user who saved them (c-183, c-184). A template saved with no name is 'Untitled template'. A template is saved only by the form post (c-188).
acceptanceCriteria: The template review's 'Save template' button saves the template, even with only some sections answered, and returns to Manage templates with the new template first in the list and the count one higher, such as 'Show 1-1 of 1 results' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 actions 72-78; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:166-169; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 20; c-188)

After saving, Manage templates shows a GOV.UK success notification banner with role alert, titled 'Success', headed '<template title> saved to templates' (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:24-37; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 78; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:168)

The banner shows once: it is gone on reload; it does not dismiss itself and stays on the page, with or without JavaScript, until the trader leaves or reloads (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:24-37; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 97; c-006)

A template saved with no name is titled 'Untitled template': the banner reads 'Untitled template saved to templates' and it is listed first (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T10 actions 14-16; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:174, 182)

Each template is a card labelled 'Template <title>' showing the template's category label above its title, which is an H3, with a 'View template' link to the template's page and, beside it, a GOV.UK secondary button 'Use template' in a form (prototype:dr2-1-source partials/design-release-2.1/dashboard-template-card.html:2-11; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 actions 19-24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:24-25; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 11, 47; c-309)
With two templates saved one after the other, the list shows the later one first (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-012; c-183)
A saved template is still listed after the user signs out and signs back in (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claim 10; c-183)
A template is private to the user who saved it: another signed-in user does not see it on their Manage templates and cannot open it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-098; c-184)
A saved template never appears among the user's notifications on the dashboard (c-183)
notes: Re-distil (9 October afternoon ruling): the card's 'Use template' is now a GOV.UK secondary button in a form that posts, keeping the design's wording, because using a template stores a draft and every state change is a form post (req-1303, c-309). What pressing it does is built and observed in the use row (inc-160).

Combines saving (req-1340, req-1319), the success banner (req-1307, req-1308), the list order and card frame (req-1301, req-1302, req-1303) and privacy (req-1311): saving is the first moment a template exists, so each is first seen here. The card's answer rows and category rule are in the card-answers row. The cross-user criterion uses a second test user, as the address book's cross-user spec does. The success banner pattern is reused by the delete, discard and change rows.
Combiner: the review-and-submit area's 'Save template' criterion (req-942) is the same button; it stays in inc-156.

rows.title: View a saved template
rows.detail: A saved template has its own page: its title as the heading, the date it was created, every saved answer in the same cards as the notification review with a Change link on each, a 'Use template' button that posts (c-309) and a 'Delete' button, with no Edit action (c-261). Opening the page of a template that does not exist, has been deleted or belongs to another user goes back to Manage templates.
acceptanceCriteria: 'View template' opens the template page, with the caption 'Templates' above the template's title, which is its H1 and its page title ('<template name> - Import notification service - GOV.UK') (prototype:dr2-1-source view-template.html:8,46-47; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 actions 8-11; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:40-44; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 21)
The template page shows 'Date created: <d Month yyyy>' with the day the template was saved (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 12; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:45)

The template page has a primary 'Use template' submit button in a form and a red warning 'Delete' button (prototype:dr2-1-source view-template.html:55-66; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 actions 13-14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:46-47; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 47; c-309)
The template page's Back link goes to Manage templates (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-049; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 15; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:50)
The template page has no Edit button or link (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-050; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-055; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 82; c-261)

The template page lists the answers in the notification review's cards, in the review's numbered sections without the documents section, renumbered to run 1 to 5: section 1 holds Origin of import, What are you importing? and the import reason; section 2 a card per commodity '<common name> (<code>)' with species, Number of animals, Number of packages when required, the identification details table, and an Additional details card; section 3 Arrival details and Transport details; section 4 the consignment's addresses; section 5 the contact address; every card has a Change link (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 actions 16, 20; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:38, 48-49; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 31)

A live animals template saved after answering every section shows on its page the country and region of origin, internal reference, commodity codes, common names and species, reason for import, purpose in the market, certified for, unweaned animals, animal and package totals and per-species numbers, net weight, package type, animal identification details, port of entry, means of transport, transport identification, transport document reference, the transporter's name, address, country, approval number and type, and the CPH number (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-041, p14-042; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 20)

Each card's Change link opens the change of that section of the saved template: origin of the import, what you are importing, reason for import, consignment details (on the commodity card header and its number-of-animals row), animal identification details, additional animal details, arrival details, transporter, roles and addresses and contact address (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 15; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103)

Opening the page of a template that has been deleted, of one that does not exist, or of another user's template goes to Manage templates (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-021; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T6 actions 11-12; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:84-85; c-184)
notes: Re-distil (9 October afternoon and templates rulings): 'Use template' on the page is a submit button in a form that posts, looking as designed (req-1349, c-309). The section criterion follows the notification review's own numbered sections rather than Design Release 2.1's new headings, so it holds before and after the review's heading row (inc-101) lands, which the templates ruling says a template row does not wait for (claims 6, 31-33). The not-found criterion adds another user's template, as req-1312 says.

Combines the template page (req-1347 to req-1353), what a saved template holds (req-1344, first observable on this page) and the not-found rule (req-1312). req-1312 also names the change, use and delete pages; each of those rows observes it for its own page as it lands (inc-159, inc-160, inc-165).
The Addresses and Contact address cards' party content is in the card-answers row (req-1346). The page reuses the notification review cards.

rows.title: Change one section of a saved template
rows.detail: A Change link on a template's page opens that section's question page prefilled with the template's answers, with only 'Save and return' and a 'Cancel' link. Following the link stores nothing (c-309). Saving updates the template, never a draft notification, resets its date created, and returns to the template page with a success banner that stays until the trader leaves or reloads. A template never holds an arrival date, before or after a change.
acceptanceCriteria: Following a Change link on a template's page opens that section's question page prefilled with the template's answers, ready to edit; an unanswered optional field is empty, never 'Not applicable' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T5 action 14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:64-71; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 22)

When changing a template section, the question page's only submit button is 'Save and return', beside a 'Cancel' link back to the template page, with none of the amend or journey buttons (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T5 actions 10-14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:68-69; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-166)
When changing a template section, the question page's Back link returns to the template page (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T5 action 12)

Saving a changed section returns to the template page, which shows the new answer and a success banner titled 'Success' headed '<template name> has been updated'; the user's draft notifications on the dashboard are unchanged (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T5 actions 18-26; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:72-75)
A template with no name, once a section is changed and saved, shows the banner 'Template has been updated' (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-167)

The template page's banner shows once: it is gone on reload; it does not dismiss itself and stays, with or without JavaScript, until the trader leaves or reloads (prototype:dr2-1-source view-template.html:28-41; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 97; c-006)

Changing and saving each section the template page links to (origin, what you are importing, reason for import, consignment details, animal identification details, additional animal details, arrival details, transporter, roles and addresses and contact address) updates the template and returns to its page with the new answer (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-183; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 15)
After a section is changed and saved, the template page's 'Date created' shows the day of that save (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T5 action 26)

A template never shows or holds an arrival date or time: answering one on the arrival page while creating it, or while changing its arrival details section, leaves the template page with no arrival date or time (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-043, p14-043-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 20)

Following a Change link and leaving the page without saving, then opening the template page again, abandons the change: the template keeps its saved answers (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-054, p14-056; c-309)

The change of a template that has been deleted, or of another user's template, goes to Manage templates (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-021; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:84-85; c-184)
notes: Re-distil (9 October afternoon ruling): following a Change link stores nothing until the page is saved (req-1356, c-309), observed by the abandon criterion. Banners stay until the trader leaves or reloads (claim 97, c-006). The not-found criterion adds another user's template (req-1312).

Combines the change journey (req-1356, req-1358 to req-1361), the template page banner and abandon rule (req-1354) and the date-created reset (req-1343), all seen only by changing a saved section, plus the arrival-date rule (req-1345), whose second half needs a change. Eleven criteria because each section's change is reviewed once; split by section only if the plan finds it too big.

The 'Save and return' and 'Cancel' actions change the shared save-actions chrome every question page uses, and take precedence over the amend ending (req-1358). Changing a section is template mode on the same question pages, never a copy (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 5, 30).

rows.title: Use a template to start a notification
rows.detail: 'Use template', a form post from a template's card or its page (c-309), creates and saves a new draft notification in the template's own set, seeded from the template's answers, and opens its normal notification task list with a new GBN-AG reference. The arrival date is left to answer, no documents are carried, and the new notification starts with no validation errors. Other drafts are left untouched (c-183).
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing 'Use template', on a live animals template's card or on its template page, creates a new live animals draft notification and opens its task list headed 'Notification tasklist' with the status 'Draft' and a new GBN-AG notification reference made the same way as any new notification's; the new draft is listed on the dashboard and the user's other drafts are unchanged (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T4 actions 7-14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:54-59; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 27, 51; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 23; c-183; c-309)

The new notification uses the set's normal task list, including '4. Documents' and '5. Consignment parties', ending with 'Review and submit' and 'Return to dashboard', which goes to the live animals set's own notification list, and nothing on it names the template it came from (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T4 action 14; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-081)
Its overview shows the template's animal and package totals under 'Your commodities' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T4 action 14)

It is seeded with the template's country of origin, region of origin ('Yes' with the code when the template has one, 'No' when not) and internal reference (blank when none) (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-062, p14-063)

It is seeded with the template's commodities and species, the commodity selections, animal and package numbers per species, net weight, package type and animal identification details (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-064 to p14-066; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 51)
It is seeded with the main reason for import, and with the purpose in the internal market only when the reason is 'Internal market' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-067)

It is seeded with 'Certified for' when the template's value is a valid option, otherwise 'Further keeping'; and with the unweaned animals answer when valid for the species, 'No' when the species have unweaned options and the template has none (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-068, p14-070; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 57)

It is seeded with the CPH number, port of entry, means of transport, transport identification and transport document reference, and leaves the arrival date empty, so Arrival details and Upload documents show 'To do' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-072; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T4 action 14)
It is seeded with the transporter's name, address, country, approval number and type (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-042; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 20; c-187)
It carries no documents and shows no validation errors when first opened (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-075)
Using a template that has been deleted, or another user's template, goes to Manage templates and creates no notification (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-021; c-184)

sources.ref: claim 47; p3-081 (the set's own notification list)

notes: Re-distil (9 October afternoon ruling): using a template is a form post, never a GET (req-1363, c-309); 'Return to dashboard' on the new notification goes to the set's own notification list, which for live animals stays in the animals frontend (req-1364; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 3). The not-found criterion adds another user's template (req-1312).

Combines every seeding rule (req-1363 to req-1365, req-1367 to req-1372): one action, one new notification, one set-up per check. Eleven criteria because the seeding rules are reviewed one by one; split only if the plan finds it too big.

Germinal: using a germinal products template, which starts a germinal products notification in the germinal set, is observed in req-1876's row once the germinal set exists; every criterion here is observed with a live animals template. Seeding party and contact addresses is in the card-answers row. Creating a seeded draft resembles copy-as-new: the plan may reuse the notification copy path.

rows.title: Template card answers, category and each party's address
rows.detail: Each template card lists Commodity, Origin, Consignee and Consignor and is labelled with the set the template was made in (c-266). A template saves each consignment party's address and the contact address as answered, shows them on its page, and seeds each back into a notification started from it, because the real notification persists and sends each party separately (c-186).
acceptanceCriteria: Each template card lists, in this order, Commodity (the commodity common names), Origin (the country of origin), Consignee (the consignee's name) and Consignor (the consignor's name), each reading 'Not applicable' when the template has no answer; a template saved with nothing answered shows 'Not applicable' for all four (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-template-card.html:15-34; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T9 action 78, T10 action 16; c-186)

A template made as a live animals template is labelled 'Live animals' on its card (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T1 action 24; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 51; c-266)

A template saves the place of origin, consignor, consignee, importer, place of destination and contact address each as answered, and its page's Addresses card (Place of origin, Consignor, Consignee, Importer, Place of destination) and Contact address card show each of them as the design renders them (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T3 action 20; c-186)
Where the contact address was not chosen, the template's Contact address card shows the place of origin, as the design does (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-045; c-186)
A notification started from a template has each party and the contact address seeded as the template holds them (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-071, p14-074; c-186)

sources.ref: T1 action 24; T3 action 20; T9 action 78; T10 action 16

notes: Unchanged by the 9 October afternoon and templates rulings: the category is the set the template was made in (c-266) and party addresses are kept separately (c-186).

Combines the card's answer rows (req-1304), the category label (req-1305) and party addresses (req-1346): the card's Consignee and Consignor come from the same saved party addresses. Depends on the save, view and use rows, since its criteria are seen on all three.

Germinal: the 'Germinal products' half of req-1305 is observed in req-1876's row once the germinal set exists; here the label is observed for a live animals template, so the row needs no dependency on the germinal theme.

rows.title: A sort on Manage templates that really reorders, as design answers question 11
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 draws an inert 'Sort by:' select on Manage templates (Select one, Newest first, Oldest first, Arrival date) that sits outside any form and reorders nothing. A control that does nothing is not shipped, and templates hold no arrival date, so the 9 October afternoon ruling builds Manage templates without it (req-1300) and puts the sort to design as question 11. If design asks for a sort, it is built as a GET form whose button really reorders the list, with the options design names; if design drops it, this row is dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: Manage templates has a 'Sort by' control, a GOV.UK select in a form with its own button, offering the options design question 11 names and none that templates cannot hold, such as an arrival date (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 93-94; c-185)

With two templates saved on different days, choosing each option and pressing the button reorders the list as that option names, and the chosen option stays selected on the reordered page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 94; c-185)
The sort works the same without JavaScript: the button submits the form and the page comes back reordered (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 46; c-185)
Choosing a sort leaves the results count and the cards' content unchanged (prototype:dr2-1-source dashboard-templates.html:61; c-185)
openQuestions: Design answers design question 11 (templates sort): whether Manage templates gets a sort that really reorders the list and, if so, which options it offers. Built as design says, or this row is dropped if design drops the sort (req-1299 blockedBy; c-185).
notes: Re-distil (9 October afternoon ruling): c-185 now replaces the inert select the earlier row built. The ruling moves the whole sort row to the waiting-on-design theme (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 93), so this row is blocked on design question 11 and the combiner should give it that theme rather than type-question-and-templates; its touches sit inside the templates folder, which the combiner must square with the theme boundary (the row lands after the templates theme, so it can take that folder once the templates theme is split off or landed). The earlier criteria (the four inert options, outside any form, no reorder) are withdrawn with c-185's earlier outcome.
Depends on inc-157: the reorder criterion needs two saved templates. The dependency on the INS dashboard's sort row (inc-136) stays removed: the templates sort is its own control.

Whether the store or the frontend sorts is the plan's call once design names the options; backend is not listed because newest-first is already the stored order and the options design is likely to name sort on the date created. Add backend in the re-distil if design names an option the store must sort on.

rows.title: Discard a template being created
rows.detail: A template being created can be thrown away from its review, through the same 'Delete this template?' confirmation, without being saved. The confirmation uses the journey layout. The discard page shows only while a template is being created, and the discard is a form post (c-309).
acceptanceCriteria: On the review of a template being created, the red warning 'Delete' button opens a page with the H1 'Delete this template?', a one-row summary list keyed 'Name' holding the name entered ('this template' when none), 'Confirm that you want to delete this template.' and 'This action cannot be undone.' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T11 actions 14-21; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:185-195; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 24)
The discard confirmation's Back link and 'No, cancel' link go to the template review (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T11 actions 19-21; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:193-195)
The discard confirmation uses the journey layout, not the dashboard layout (prototype:dr2-1-source delete-template.html:1,23)

Confirming 'Yes, delete' throws the template away unsaved and returns to Manage templates, list and count unchanged, with the success banner '<template name> has been deleted' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T11 actions 25-28; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:197-199)
Discarding a template with no name entered shows the banner 'Template has been deleted' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-087; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-185)

Opening the discard page when no template is being created goes to Manage templates, and confirming it then changes nothing and returns to Manage templates (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T12 actions 7-8; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:202-204)
notes: Combines the discard page (req-1380), its guard (req-1381), the outcome (req-1382) and the journey layout rule (req-1378, which the delete row's confirmation also keeps; observed for that page in inc-165). The prototype's unguarded discard post is not reproduced (req-1386 out of scope).

Combiner: req-943 (the review's Delete button, review-and-submit area) sits in inc-165; with the whole-template edit dropped (c-261) only its discard half is left, which this row's first criterion already observes, so consider moving req-943 here.

rows.title: Delete a saved template
rows.detail: A saved template can be deleted from its own page with Design Release 2.1's 'Delete this template?' confirmation, whose 'Yes, delete' posts the deletion, and Manage templates confirms it with a banner.
acceptanceCriteria: The template page's 'Delete' button opens a page titled 'Delete this template? - Import notification service - GOV.UK' with the H1 'Delete this template?', using the journey layout (prototype:dr2-1-source delete-template.html:1,6,23; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 actions 8-11; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:102-107; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 103)

The confirmation shows a one-row summary list keyed 'Name' holding the template's title (prototype:dr2-1-source delete-confirmation.html:6-8; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 action 12; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:109)

Under the summary it says 'Confirm that you want to delete this template.' and 'This action cannot be undone.' (prototype:dr2-1-source delete-confirmation.html:9-11; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 actions 13-14; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:110-111)

It has a red warning 'Yes, delete' submit button and a 'No, cancel' link back to the template page, in a GOV.UK button group; opening the confirmation alone deletes nothing (prototype:dr2-1-source delete-confirmation.html:13-21; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 actions 15-18; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:112; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 47)
Its Back link goes to the template page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-080; trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 action 16; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:107)

Confirming 'Yes, delete' removes the template and returns to Manage templates with one template fewer in the count and the success banner '<title> has been deleted', which stays until the trader leaves or reloads (trace:prototype-dr2-1 T8 actions 22-29; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/templates.fit.spec.js:114-117; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 97; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 25)

After deletion the template's page and its delete confirmation go to Manage templates, as does the delete confirmation of another user's template (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-021; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p7-184; c-184)
notes: Combines the delete confirmation (req-1373 to req-1377), the outcome and banner (req-1379, req-1309). Depends on the view row (the Delete button) and the discard row (the shared confirmation page). Deleted templates are removed from the store, so the prototype's seeded-template resurrection does not arise (c-183).

Combiner: keep inc-165's id. The review-and-submit area's req-943 sat here; its criterion still speaks of 'a saved template being edited', which c-261 dropped, so its draft should say only the discard half, and it may move to inc-164 (see that row's note).

rows.title: Germinal products templates are answered on the germinal set's pages, and using one starts a germinal notification
rows.detail: A germinal products template is answered on the germinal set's own question pages in template mode, so it never asks additional details, a CPH number or a permanent address. It is saved, listed with the category 'Germinal products', viewed, changed and deleted like any template, and using it starts a germinal products notification seeded with the answers that fit the germinal set.
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing Germinal products on the type question in template creation, then naming the template, opens the germinal set's origin page in template mode with the 'Template' caption and name; the template's task list has no Additional details task and it asks no CPH number or permanent address (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 16-18, 127; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 26-30)

A saved germinal products template is listed on Manage templates with the category 'Germinal products', and is viewed, changed and deleted like any template (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 51; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-066; c-266)

Pressing 'Use template' on a germinal products template starts a germinal products draft notification in the germinal set, with a GBN-AG reference, and opens the germinal set's task list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 6, 51; c-266; c-309)

Using a germinal products template seeds the main reason for import, the purpose in the internal market only when the reason is 'Internal market', and the storage temperature only when it is one of the germinal products temperature options (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-067, p14-069; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 21)
A notification started from a germinal products template is certified for 'Germinal products', and nothing about unweaned animals is asked or seeded (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 19, 57)

sources.ref: claims 26-30 (template mode on the same pages)

notes: Drafted by this area for the first time: the earlier combiner drafted inc-186 because no area did. Combiner: keep inc-186's id and its germinal-products theme, and keep the germinal area's req-1740 (the germinal origin page's Back link, its template-review clause) merged here as before.

Template mode on the germinal pages is the same template mode the live-animals pages get (inc-154 onwards), applied to the germinal set's own pages, never a copied template journey (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 5, 30).

Dependencies: under ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 6 keep only rows that create something this needs: the germinal set's pages (inc-182 and the germinal rows before it) and the templates rows it reuses (inc-151, inc-154 to inc-161, inc-164, inc-165). Drop any dependency kept only because a page's look will change.
